' ============================================================================
' DEFENDER - ZX Spectrum Next Edition (Layer 2 + 16x16 256-Colour Sprites)
' ============================================================================
' NTC BASIC. Built on the original (original_Main.bas): its world, its sprite hardware code,
' its landers, mutants, humans and scanner, with better graphics, sound and play:
'   - 16 sprite patterns (two frames for the ship, landers, mutants and humans, an enemy shot,
'     an explosion, the baiter) in SprData.cls (or DEFENDER.SPR where files work)
'   - stars behind, scrolling slower than the ground (the copper: Scroll.cls), a longer and
'     less regular landscape, the scanner showing where the screen is
'   - sounds for everything on the AY (Sfx.cls): laser, explosions, abductions, catches, the
'     smart bomb, hyperspace, the thrust
'   - losing a ship doesn't start the wave again; a moment's safety after; the ship turns round
'     smoothly; humans walk, fall (from high up they die), get caught and set down (500 each);
'     the baiter comes if a wave drags on; an extra ship and smart bomb every 10,000; the
'     humans and the planet come back every fifth wave
' The words are on the tilemap (Board.cls), the drawing on Layer 2 (L2.cls).
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

' ZX Spectrum Next Hardware Ports
Const PORT_NEXTREG_SEL As Integer = &H243B
Const PORT_NEXTREG_DAT As Integer = &H253B
Const PORT_SPRITE_SLOT As Integer = &H303B
Const PORT_SPRITE_ATTR As Integer = &H57
Const PORT_SPRITE_PAT  As Integer = &H5B

' World & Layer 2 Screen Constants (Layer 2 = 256x192, Sprites offset +32,+32; y counts up)
Const WORLD_W As Integer = 1024
Const WORLD_MASK As Integer = 1023
Const SPR_X_OFF As Integer = 32
Const SPR_Y_OFF As Integer = 32
Const PLAY_TOP As Integer = 30
Const PLAY_BOT As Integer = 146

' Sprite Pattern Indices (SprData.cls / DEFENDER.SPR)
Const PAT_PLAYER As Integer = 0
Const PAT_LANDER As Integer = 1
Const PAT_MUTANT As Integer = 2
Const PAT_HUMAN  As Integer = 3
Const PAT_BOLT   As Integer = 4
Const PAT_FRAME2 As Integer = 4      ' + this: the second frame of 0-3 (ship, lander, mutant, human)
Const PAT_SHOT   As Integer = 9
Const PAT_BOOM   As Integer = 10     ' 10-13
Const PAT_BAITER As Integer = 14     ' 14-15

' Hardware Sprite Slot Allocations
Const SLOT_PLAYER As Integer = 0
Const SLOT_LASER0 As Integer = 1
Const SLOT_HUMAN0 As Integer = 5
Const SLOT_ENEMY0 As Integer = 13
Const SLOT_SHOT0  As Integer = 23
Const SLOT_BOOM0  As Integer = 29

' Entity Counts
Const MAX_LASERS As Integer = 4
Const MAX_HUMANS As Integer = 8
Const MAX_ENEMIES As Integer = 10
Const MAX_SHOTS As Integer = 6
Const MAX_BOOMS As Integer = 4

' Enemy States
Const ST_DEAD As Integer = 0
Const ST_WANDER As Integer = 1
Const ST_DESCEND As Integer = 2
Const ST_ABDUCT As Integer = 3
Const ST_MUTANT As Integer = 4
Const ST_BAITER As Integer = 5

Const H_DEAD As Integer = 0
Const H_GROUND As Integer = 1
Const H_GRABBED As Integer = 2
Const H_FALLING As Integer = 3
Const H_CARRIED As Integer = 4

' Layer 2 colours (RRRGGGBB)
Const COL_TERRAIN As Integer = &HC8
Const COL_SCANNER As Integer = &H0B
Const COL_DIVIDER As Integer = &H8B

' Player State
Dim px As Integer, py As Integer
Dim pvx As Integer, pvy As Integer
Dim pdir As Integer, psx As Integer, cam_x As Integer
Dim old_prx As Integer, old_pry As Integer
Dim thrust As Integer, safeT As Integer

Dim score As Long, nextBonus As Long
Dim lives As Integer
Dim bombs As Integer
Dim wave As Integer
Dim game_over As Boolean
Dim planet_dead As Boolean
Dim fire_cd As Integer
Dim bomb_cd As Integer
Dim hyper_cd As Integer
Dim flash_bg As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, waveT As Integer, baiterT As Integer, hudDirty As Integer

' Lasers
Dim lx(MAX_LASERS) As Integer
Dim ly(MAX_LASERS) As Integer
Dim lvx(MAX_LASERS) As Integer
Dim lscr(MAX_LASERS) As Integer, lasersOn As Integer
Dim llife(MAX_LASERS) As Integer

' Humanoids
Dim hx(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hy(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hstate(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hcarrier(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hdir(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim hfall(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer, hvy(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim old_hrx(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer, old_hry(MAX_HUMANS) As Integer
Dim humans_alive As Integer

' Enemies
Dim ex(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim ey(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim evx(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim evy(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim estate(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim etarget(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim old_erx(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim old_ery(MAX_ENEMIES) As Integer
Dim enemies_alive As Integer
Dim spawn_timer As Integer
Dim enemies_to_spawn As Integer

' Enemy Projectiles
Dim sx(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim sy(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim svx(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim svy(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer
Dim slife(MAX_SHOTS) As Integer

' Explosions (world x, y, frames to go)
Dim bx(MAX_BOOMS) As Integer, by(MAX_BOOMS) As Integer, bt(MAX_BOOMS) As Integer

' The landscape: a height for each 4 pixels of the world (256 of them)
Dim land(255) As Integer, yh(1023) As Byte
' Layer 2's terrain columns, the scanner's view marks
Dim ycol(255) As Integer, tcam As Integer, terOn As Integer, terDead As Boolean, mark0 As Integer

' The CPC-style statements the original used (Plot / Draw with a pen, bottom-up y), on the Next
Dim gx As Integer, gy As Integer, penc(15) As Integer, txtPen As Integer, atx As Integer, aty As Integer
Dim sprbuf(4607) As Byte
Dim i As Integer, j As Integer, k As Integer, rs As Long

' ============================================================================
' ZX SPECTRUM NEXT HARDWARE REGISTER & SPRITE HELPERS
' ============================================================================

Sub WriteNextReg(ByVal reg As Integer, ByVal val As Integer)
    Out PORT_NEXTREG_SEL, reg
    Out PORT_NEXTREG_DAT, val
End Sub

' Loads DEFENDER.SPR (512B 9-bit palette + 16x 256B 16x16 8-bit sprites), else the built-in set
Sub LoadSpriteTilemap(ByVal filename As String)
    ' Sprites visible, over the border; SUL (the words on the tilemap over Layer 2)
    WriteNextReg(&H15, &H0B)
    ' Sprite transparency index = 0
    WriteNextReg(&H4B, &H00)
    If FileSystem.Load(filename, VarPtr(sprbuf), 4608) = 4608 Then
        WriteNextReg(&H43, &H20)
        WriteNextReg(&H40, 0)
        For i = 0 To 255
            WriteNextReg(&H44, sprbuf(i * 2))
            WriteNextReg(&H44, sprbuf(i * 2 + 1))
        Next i
        Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, 0
        For i = 512 To 4607
            Out PORT_SPRITE_PAT, sprbuf(i)
        Next i
    Else
        SprData.Upload
    End If
End Sub

' Updates a hardware sprite slot (px_scr in 0..255 Layer 2 coords, py_scr in 0..191, y up)
Sub SetHardwareSprite(ByVal slot As Integer, ByVal px_scr As Integer, ByVal py_scr As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal hflip As Boolean, ByVal visible As Boolean)
    Dim sx1 As Integer, sy1 As Integer, attr2 As Integer
    Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, slot
    If Not visible Then
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Exit Sub
    End If
    sx1 = px_scr + SPR_X_OFF - 8
    sy1 = (191 - py_scr) + SPR_Y_OFF - 8
    attr2 = (sx1 \ 256) And 1
    If hflip Then attr2 = attr2 Or 8
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, sx1 And 255
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, sy1 And 255
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, attr2
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 192 Or (pat And 63)
    Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
End Sub

Sub HideSprite(ByVal slot As Integer)
    SetHardwareSprite(slot, 0, 0, 0, False, False)
End Sub

Sub HideAllSprites()
    Dim s As Integer
    Out PORT_SPRITE_SLOT, 0
    For s = 0 To 63
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
        Out PORT_SPRITE_ATTR, 0
    Next s
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' COORDINATE & TERRAIN HELPERS
' ============================================================================

' the landscape, made once: hills and mountains wandering up and down (no more than 4 pixels
' each 4 across, so the line has no gaps)
Sub MakeLand()
    Dim h As Integer, t As Integer
    rs = 12345 : h = 14 : t = 14
    For k = 0 To 255
        If k Mod 16 = 0 Then t = 8 + Rand(23)
        If h < t Then h = h + 1 + Rand(3)
        If h > t Then h = h - 1 - Rand(3)
        If h < 8 Then h = 8
        If h > 32 Then h = 32
        land(k) = h
    Next k
    ' the last few lead back to the first, so it joins all the way round
    For k = 248 To 255
        land(k) = land(247) + (land(0) - land(247)) * (k - 247) \ 9
    Next k
End Sub

Function Rand(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
    rs = (rs * 1103515245 + 12345) And &H7FFFFFFF
    Rand = CInt((rs \ 65536) Mod n)
End Function

Function GetTerrainY(ByVal wx As Integer) As Integer
    If planet_dead Then GetTerrainY = 6 Else GetTerrainY = land((wx \ 4) And 255)
End Function

Function WorldToScreenX(ByVal wx As Integer, ByVal cx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim d As Integer
    d = (wx - cx) And WORLD_MASK
    If d >= 512 Then d = d - 1024
    WorldToScreenX = d
End Function

Function WorldToRadarX(ByVal wx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim rel As Integer
    rel = (wx - px + 512) And WORLD_MASK
    WorldToRadarX = 64 + (rel \ 8)
End Function

Sub UpdateHUD()
    Pen 15
    At 1, 1
    PrintS Right$("000000" & Mid$(Str$(score), 2), 7)
    Pen 14
    At 10, 1
    PrintS "SHIPS" & Str$(lives) & " "
    Pen 12
    At 19, 1
    PrintS "BOMBS" & Str$(bombs) & " "
    Pen 11
    At 27, 1
    PrintS "WAVE" & Str$(wave) & " "
    hudDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub DrawStaticFrame()
    ClsAll
    ' Scanner divider and radar box (x = 62..193, y = 152..183 in bottom-up Layer 2 coords)
    L2.Rect 0, 43, 256, 1, COL_DIVIDER
    Plot 62, 152, 12
    Draw 193, 152, 12
    Draw 193, 182, 12
    Draw 62, 182, 12
    Draw 62, 152, 12
    Stars
    mark0 = -1
    UpdateHUD()
End Sub

' the stars: scattered over the sky (Layer 2 lines 44-158), scrolled slowly by the copper
Sub Stars()
    Dim x As Integer, y As Integer
    rs = 777
    For k = 0 To 59
        x = Rand(256) : y = 46 + Rand(110)
        L2.Plot x, y, Val(Mid$("073146219255", (k Mod 4) * 3 + 1, 3))
    Next k
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' WAVE & ENTITY MANAGEMENT
' ============================================================================

Sub InitWave()
    HideAllSprites()
    DrawStaticFrame()

    px = 512 : py = 96 : pvx = 0 : pvy = 0 : pdir = 1 : psx = 88
    old_prx = 128 : old_pry = 165
    safeT = 50

    For i = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
        llife(i) = 0
    Next i
    For i = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
        slife(i) = 0
    Next i
    For i = 0 To MAX_BOOMS - 1
        bt(i) = 0
    Next i

    ' the humans: all of them at the start, and back again every fifth wave
    If wave = 1 Or (wave - 1) Mod 5 = 0 Then
        planet_dead = False
        humans_alive = MAX_HUMANS
        For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
            hx(i) = (i * 128 + 48) And WORLD_MASK
            hstate(i) = H_GROUND
        Next i
    End If
    For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
        old_hrx(i) = 0
        hcarrier(i) = -1
        If hstate(i) <> H_DEAD Then
            hstate(i) = H_GROUND
            hy(i) = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
        End If
        If Rand(2) Then hdir(i) = 1 Else hdir(i) = -1
    Next i

    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        estate(i) = ST_DEAD
        old_erx(i) = 0
    Next i

    enemies_to_spawn = 10 + wave * 2
    If enemies_to_spawn > 24 Then enemies_to_spawn = 24
    enemies_alive = 0
    spawn_timer = 10
    waveT = 0 : baiterT = 0

    For i = 0 To 4
        SpawnEnemy()
    Next i
    UpdateHUD()
    Message "WAVE" & Str$(wave), 60
End Sub

Sub SpawnEnemy()
    If enemies_to_spawn <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) = ST_DEAD Then
            ex(i) = (px + 250 + Rnd(500)) And WORLD_MASK
            ey(i) = 110 + Rnd(30)
            If Rnd(2) = 0 Then evx(i) = 1 Else evx(i) = -1
            evy(i) = -1
            If planet_dead Then estate(i) = ST_MUTANT Else estate(i) = ST_WANDER
            etarget(i) = -1
            old_erx(i) = 0
            enemies_alive = enemies_alive + 1
            enemies_to_spawn = enemies_to_spawn - 1
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' the baiter: a fast saucer that comes for you when a wave goes on too long
Sub SpawnBaiter()
    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) = ST_DEAD Then
            ex(i) = (px + 300) And WORLD_MASK
            ey(i) = py
            estate(i) = ST_BAITER
            evx(i) = 0 : evy(i) = 0
            etarget(i) = -1 : old_erx(i) = 0
            Sfx.Play 1, 40, 2, 13, 25, 0
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub FireLaser()
    For i = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
        If llife(i) = 0 Then
            lx(i) = (px + pdir * 12) And WORLD_MASK
            ly(i) = py - 1
            lvx(i) = pdir * 16 + pvx
            llife(i) = 14
            Sfx.Play 0, 24, 5, 12, 9, 0
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub Boom(ByVal wx As Integer, ByVal wy As Integer)
    For k = 0 To MAX_BOOMS - 1
        If bt(k) = 0 Then
            bx(k) = wx : by(k) = wy : bt(k) = 16
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next k
End Sub

Sub KillEnemy(ByVal idx As Integer)
    Dim h As Integer
    HideSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + idx)
    If old_erx(idx) > 0 Then
        Plot old_erx(idx), old_ery(idx), 0
        old_erx(idx) = 0
    End If
    Boom ex(idx), ey(idx)

    h = etarget(idx)
    If h >= 0 And h < MAX_HUMANS Then
        If hstate(h) = H_GRABBED And hcarrier(h) = idx Then
            hstate(h) = H_FALLING
            hcarrier(h) = -1
            hfall(h) = hy(h) : hvy(h) = 0
        End If
    End If

    If estate(idx) = ST_BAITER Then
        AddScore 200
    Else
        AddScore 150
        enemies_alive = enemies_alive - 1
    End If
    estate(idx) = ST_DEAD
    Sfx.Play 1, 10, 1, 14, 20, 1
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Integer)
    score = score + n
    If score >= nextBonus Then
        nextBonus = nextBonus + 10000
        lives = lives + 1
        If bombs < 9 Then bombs = bombs + 1
        Sfx.Play 2, 60, -1, 14, 40, 0
    End If
    hudDirty = 1
End Sub

Sub TriggerSmartBomb(ByVal cx As Integer)
    Dim sx_pos As Integer
    If bombs <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    bombs = bombs - 1
    bomb_cd = 25
    Sfx.Play 2, 4, 1, 15, 45, 1
    Border 7
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, 0, &HFF
    flash_bg = 4

    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) <> ST_DEAD Then
            sx_pos = WorldToScreenX(ex(i), cx)
            If sx_pos >= -16 And sx_pos <= 272 Then KillEnemy(i)
        End If
    Next i
    For i = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
        slife(i) = 0
    Next i
    hudDirty = 1
End Sub

' the ship's hit: it blows up, the others clear off a little, a moment's safety, and on
Sub LoseLife()
    Dim f As Integer
    Sfx.Play 2, 6, 1, 15, 70, 1
    Sfx.Play 0, 150, 6, 14, 60, 0
    For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
        If hstate(i) = H_CARRIED Then
            hstate(i) = H_FALLING : hfall(i) = hy(i) : hvy(i) = 0
        End If
    Next i
    For f = 0 To 59
        SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_PLAYER, psx, py, PAT_BOOM + (f \ 4) Mod 4, False, (f < 40))
        If f Mod 8 < 4 Then Border 2 Else Border 0
        Vsync
    Next f
    Border 0
    lives = lives - 1
    If lives <= 0 Then
        HideAllSprites()
        game_over = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' the enemies near the ship are moved away, the shots gone
    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) <> ST_DEAD Then
            If Abs(WorldToScreenX(ex(i), px)) < 200 Then ex(i) = (ex(i) + 400) And WORLD_MASK
            If estate(i) = ST_BAITER Then
                estate(i) = ST_DEAD : HideSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i)
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    For i = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
        slife(i) = 0
    Next i
    py = 96 : pvx = 0 : safeT = 100 : baiterT = 0
    hudDirty = 1
End Sub

' a message in the middle of the play area for a while
Dim msgT As Integer
Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal t As Integer)
    Pen 14
    At 17 - Len(m) \ 2, 11
    PrintS m
    msgT = t
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' THE PARTS OF A FRAME
' ============================================================================

Sub Controls()
    j = Joy(0)
    ' Up: Q (3) or Joy Up (8) | Down: A (2) or Joy Down (4)
    If Key(3) Or (j And 8) <> 0 Then
        If pvy < 3 Then pvy = pvy + 1
    ElseIf Key(2) Or (j And 4) <> 0 Then
        If pvy > -3 Then pvy = pvy - 1
    Else
        pvy = 0
    End If

    ' Left: O (33) or Joy Left (2) | Right: P (32) or Joy Right (1)
    thrust = 0
    If Key(33) Or (j And 2) <> 0 Then
        pdir = -1 : thrust = 1
        If pvx > -10 Then pvx = pvx - 1
    ElseIf Key(32) Or (j And 1) <> 0 Then
        pdir = 1 : thrust = 1
        If pvx < 10 Then pvx = pvx + 1
    ElseIf frames Mod 3 = 0 Then
        If pvx > 0 Then pvx = pvx - 1
        If pvx < 0 Then pvx = pvx + 1
    End If
    If thrust And Sfx.Busy(2) = 0 Then Sfx.Play 2, 28, 0, 5, 3, 1

    px = (px + pvx) And WORLD_MASK
    py = py + pvy
    If py < PLAY_TOP Then py = PLAY_TOP
    If py > PLAY_BOT Then py = PLAY_BOT

    ' the ship sits to one side, leaving room ahead: turning round, it slides across
    If pdir > 0 And psx > 88 Then psx = psx - 4
    If pdir < 0 And psx < 168 Then psx = psx + 4
    cam_x = (px - psx) And WORLD_MASK

    ' Fire Laser: Space (40), Z (9), or Joy Fire 1 (16)
    If fire_cd > 0 Then fire_cd = fire_cd - 1
    If (Key(40) Or Key(9) Or (j And 16) <> 0) And fire_cd = 0 Then
        FireLaser()
        fire_cd = 5
    End If

    ' Smart Bomb: B (36), M (34), or Joy Fire 2 (32)
    If bomb_cd > 0 Then bomb_cd = bomb_cd - 1
    If (Key(36) Or Key(34) Or (j And 32) <> 0) And bomb_cd = 0 Then TriggerSmartBomb(cam_x)

    ' Hyperspace: H (38): somewhere else, at random
    If hyper_cd > 0 Then hyper_cd = hyper_cd - 1
    If Key(38) And hyper_cd = 0 Then
        Plot old_prx, old_pry, 0
        px = Rnd(WORLD_W)
        py = 50 + Rnd(85)
        pvx = 0
        hyper_cd = 50 : safeT = 25
        Sfx.Play 0, 500, -24, 14, 20, 0
    End If
End Sub

Sub DrawPlayer()
    Dim f As Integer
    f = PAT_PLAYER
    If thrust And (frames And 2) Then f = PAT_PLAYER + PAT_FRAME2
    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_PLAYER, psx, py, f, (pdir < 0), (safeT = 0 Or (safeT And 4) = 0))
    If safeT > 0 Then safeT = safeT - 1

    Plot old_prx, old_pry, 0
    old_prx = 128
    old_pry = 154 + (py \ 7)
    Plot old_prx, old_pry, 15
End Sub

Sub Lasers()
    Dim lsx As Integer
    lasersOn = 0
    For i = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
        If llife(i) > 0 Then
            lx(i) = (lx(i) + lvx(i)) And WORLD_MASK
            llife(i) = llife(i) - 1
            lsx = WorldToScreenX(lx(i), cam_x)
            If llife(i) > 0 And lsx >= 0 And lsx <= 255 Then
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + i, lsx, ly(i), PAT_BOLT, (lvx(i) < 0), True)
                lscr(i) = lsx : lasersOn = 1
            Else
                llife(i) = 0
                HideSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + i)
            End If
        Else
            HideSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + i)
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub Humans()
    Dim hsx As Integer, hrx As Integer, hry As Integer, t_ground As Integer
    For i = 0 To MAX_HUMANS - 1
        If old_hrx(i) > 0 Then
            Plot old_hrx(i), old_hry(i), 0
            old_hrx(i) = 0
        End If

        If hstate(i) <> H_DEAD Then
            Select Case hstate(i)
            Case H_GROUND
                ' wandering about
                If frames Mod 6 = 0 Then
                    hx(i) = (hx(i) + hdir(i)) And WORLD_MASK
                    If Rnd(60) = 0 Then hdir(i) = -hdir(i)
                End If
                hy(i) = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
            Case H_CARRIED
                hx(i) = px
                hy(i) = py - 10
                t_ground = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
                If hy(i) <= t_ground Or py <= PLAY_TOP Then
                    hy(i) = t_ground
                    hstate(i) = H_GROUND
                    AddScore 500
                    Sfx.Play 0, 90, -3, 14, 20, 0
                End If
            Case H_FALLING
                If frames Mod 4 = 0 And hvy(i) < 3 Then hvy(i) = hvy(i) + 1
                hy(i) = hy(i) - hvy(i)
                If Abs(WorldToScreenX(hx(i), cam_x) - psx) < 12 And Abs(hy(i) - py) < 12 Then
                    hstate(i) = H_CARRIED
                    AddScore 500
                    Sfx.Play 0, 140, -6, 14, 14, 0
                Else
                    t_ground = GetTerrainY(hx(i)) + 6
                    If hy(i) <= t_ground Then
                        hy(i) = t_ground
                        If hfall(i) - t_ground > 60 Then
                            ' too far to fall
                            hstate(i) = H_DEAD
                            humans_alive = humans_alive - 1
                            Boom hx(i), hy(i)
                            Sfx.Play 1, 100, 12, 13, 25, 0
                            HumansGone
                        Else
                            hstate(i) = H_GROUND
                            AddScore 250
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End Select
        End If

        If hstate(i) <> H_DEAD Then
            hsx = WorldToScreenX(hx(i), cam_x)
            If hsx >= -8 And hsx <= 263 Then
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_HUMAN0 + i, hsx, hy(i), PAT_HUMAN + PAT_FRAME2 * ((frames \ 12) And 1) * (hstate(i) = H_GROUND) * -1, (hdir(i) < 0), True)
            Else
                HideSprite(SLOT_HUMAN0 + i)
            End If
            hrx = WorldToRadarX(hx(i))
            hry = 153 + (hy(i) \ 7)
            Plot hrx, hry, 13
            old_hrx(i) = hrx : old_hry(i) = hry
        Else
            HideSprite(SLOT_HUMAN0 + i)
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' no humans left: the planet goes, and every lander turns mutant
Sub HumansGone()
    If humans_alive <= 0 And Not planet_dead Then
        planet_dead = True
        Border 2
        flash_bg = 10
        Sfx.Play 2, 3, 1, 15, 60, 1
        For k = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
            If estate(k) = ST_WANDER Or estate(k) = ST_DESCEND Then estate(k) = ST_MUTANT
        Next k
        Message "THE PLANET IS GONE", 100
    End If
End Sub

Sub Enemies()
    Dim esx As Integer, erx As Integer, ery As Integer, epat As Integer, ecol As Integer
    Dim th As Integer, dx_h As Integer, l_idx As Integer, hit As Boolean, lsx As Integer, s As Integer

    If spawn_timer > 0 Then
        spawn_timer = spawn_timer - 1
    ElseIf enemies_to_spawn > 0 And enemies_alive < 7 Then
        SpawnEnemy()
        spawn_timer = 60
    End If
    ' the baiter: after 40 seconds, then every 12
    waveT = waveT + 1
    If waveT > 2000 Then
        baiterT = baiterT + 1
        If baiterT >= 600 Or waveT = 2001 Then
            baiterT = 0
            SpawnBaiter()
        End If
    End If

    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If old_erx(i) > 0 Then
            Plot old_erx(i), old_ery(i), 0
            old_erx(i) = 0
        End If

        If estate(i) <> ST_DEAD Then
            Select Case estate(i)
            Case ST_WANDER
                If frames Mod 2 = 0 Then ex(i) = (ex(i) + evx(i)) And WORLD_MASK
                If frames Mod 3 = 0 Then ey(i) = ey(i) + evy(i)
                If ey(i) < 70 Then evy(i) = 1
                If ey(i) > 140 Then evy(i) = -1
                ' now and then it picks a human below to take
                If Rnd(150) = 0 And humans_alive > 0 Then
                    th = Rnd(MAX_HUMANS)
                    If hstate(th) = H_GROUND Then
                        etarget(i) = th
                        estate(i) = ST_DESCEND
                    End If
                End If
            Case ST_DESCEND
                th = etarget(i)
                If th < 0 Or hstate(th) <> H_GROUND Then
                    estate(i) = ST_WANDER
                Else
                    dx_h = WorldToScreenX(hx(th), ex(i))
                    If dx_h > 1 Then
                        ex(i) = (ex(i) + 1) And WORLD_MASK
                    ElseIf dx_h < -1 Then
                        ex(i) = (ex(i) - 1) And WORLD_MASK
                    ElseIf ey(i) > hy(th) + 10 Then
                        ey(i) = ey(i) - 1
                    Else
                        hstate(th) = H_GRABBED
                        hcarrier(th) = i
                        estate(i) = ST_ABDUCT
                        Sfx.Play 1, 300, -16, 13, 30, 0
                        Message "HUMANOID TAKEN!", 50
                    End If
                End If
            Case ST_ABDUCT
                th = etarget(i)
                If th < 0 Or hstate(th) <> H_GRABBED Then
                    estate(i) = ST_WANDER
                Else
                    If frames Mod 2 = 0 Then ey(i) = ey(i) + 1
                    hx(th) = ex(i)
                    hy(th) = ey(i) - 10
                    If ey(i) >= 140 Then
                        hstate(th) = H_DEAD
                        humans_alive = humans_alive - 1
                        estate(i) = ST_MUTANT
                        Sfx.Play 1, 60, 8, 15, 40, 0
                        HumansGone
                    End If
                End If
            Case ST_MUTANT
                ' straight at the ship, twitching
                dx_h = WorldToScreenX(px, ex(i))
                If dx_h > 0 Then ex(i) = (ex(i) + 2 + Rnd(2)) And WORLD_MASK Else ex(i) = (ex(i) - 2 - Rnd(2)) And WORLD_MASK
                If ey(i) < py - 4 Then
                    ey(i) = ey(i) + 1 + Rnd(2)
                ElseIf ey(i) > py + 4 Then
                    ey(i) = ey(i) - 1 - Rnd(2)
                Else
                    ey(i) = ey(i) + Rnd(5) - 2
                End If
            Case ST_BAITER
                ' fast, close, and mean
                dx_h = WorldToScreenX(px, ex(i))
                If dx_h > 30 And evx(i) < 9 Then evx(i) = evx(i) + 1
                If dx_h < -30 And evx(i) > -9 Then evx(i) = evx(i) - 1
                ex(i) = (ex(i) + evx(i)) And WORLD_MASK
                If ey(i) < py Then ey(i) = ey(i) + 2 Else ey(i) = ey(i) - 2
            End Select
            If ey(i) < PLAY_TOP - 8 Then ey(i) = PLAY_TOP - 8
            If ey(i) > PLAY_BOT Then ey(i) = PLAY_BOT

            ' Laser Collision Check
            hit = False
            esx = (ex(i) - cam_x) And WORLD_MASK
            If esx >= 512 Then esx = esx - 1024
            If lasersOn Then
            For l_idx = 0 To MAX_LASERS - 1
                If llife(l_idx) > 0 Then
                    lsx = lscr(l_idx)
                    If Abs(esx - lsx) < 14 And Abs(ey(i) - ly(l_idx)) < 9 Then
                        llife(l_idx) = 0
                        HideSprite(SLOT_LASER0 + l_idx)
                        KillEnemy(i)
                        hit = True
                        Exit For
                    End If
                End If
            Next l_idx
            End If

            If Not hit Then
                If safeT = 0 And Abs(esx - psx) < 11 And Abs(ey(i) - py) < 9 Then
                    KillEnemy(i)
                    LoseLife()
                    Exit Sub
                End If

                ' Enemy Shoots (aimed), when it's on the screen and not right on top of the ship
                s = 220
                If estate(i) = ST_MUTANT Then s = 140
                If estate(i) = ST_BAITER Then s = 60
                If esx >= 12 And esx <= 244 And Abs(esx - psx) > 24 And Rnd(s) = 0 Then EnemyShot i, esx

                epat = PAT_LANDER : ecol = 12
                If estate(i) = ST_MUTANT Then epat = PAT_MUTANT : ecol = 10
                If (frames \ 8) And 1 Then epat = epat + PAT_FRAME2
                If estate(i) = ST_BAITER Then epat = PAT_BAITER + ((frames \ 4) And 1) : ecol = 14

                If esx >= -8 And esx <= 263 Then
                    SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i, esx, ey(i), epat, False, True)
                Else
                    HideSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i)
                End If

                erx = WorldToRadarX(ex(i))
                ery = 153 + (ey(i) \ 7)
                Plot erx, ery, ecol
                old_erx(i) = erx
                old_ery(i) = ery
            End If
        Else
            HideSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i)
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' a shot from enemy n at screen x esx, aimed at the ship
Sub EnemyShot(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal esx As Integer)
    Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, m As Integer
    For k = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
        If slife(k) = 0 Then
            dx = psx - esx : dy = py - ey(n)
            m = Abs(dx)
            If Abs(dy) > m Then m = Abs(dy)
            If m < 1 Then m = 1
            sx(k) = ex(n) * 4 : sy(k) = ey(n) * 4
            svx(k) = dx * 12 \ m : svy(k) = dy * 12 \ m
            slife(k) = 60
            Sfx.Play 2, 70, -3, 8, 6, 0
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next k
End Sub

Sub Shots()
    Dim ssx As Integer, wy As Integer
    For i = 0 To MAX_SHOTS - 1
        If slife(i) > 0 Then
            sx(i) = (sx(i) + svx(i)) And 4095
            sy(i) = sy(i) + svy(i)
            slife(i) = slife(i) - 1
            ssx = WorldToScreenX(sx(i) \ 4, cam_x)
            wy = sy(i) \ 4
            If slife(i) > 0 And ssx >= 0 And ssx <= 255 And wy > 20 And wy < 148 Then
                If safeT = 0 And Abs(ssx - psx) < 7 And Abs(wy - py) < 6 Then
                    slife(i) = 0
                    HideSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i)
                    LoseLife()
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i, ssx, wy, PAT_SHOT, False, True)
            Else
                slife(i) = 0
                HideSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i)
            End If
        Else
            HideSprite(SLOT_SHOT0 + i)
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub Booms()
    Dim bsx As Integer
    For k = 0 To MAX_BOOMS - 1
        If bt(k) > 0 Then
            bt(k) = bt(k) - 1
            bsx = WorldToScreenX(bx(k), cam_x)
            SetHardwareSprite(SLOT_BOOM0 + k, bsx, by(k), PAT_BOOM + (15 - bt(k)) \ 4, False, (bt(k) > 0 And bsx > -8 And bsx < 264))
        Else
            HideSprite(SLOT_BOOM0 + k)
        End If
    Next k
End Sub

' the scanner's marks showing the part of the world on the screen (just outside the box, above
' and below it)
Sub ViewMarks()
    Dim m As Integer
    m = WorldToRadarX(cam_x)
    If m = mark0 Then Exit Sub
    If mark0 >= 0 Then
        L2.Span mark0, 7, 3, 0 : L2.Span mark0 + 30, 7, 3, 0
        L2.Span mark0, 41, 3, 0 : L2.Span mark0 + 30, 41, 3, 0
    End If
    If m >= 62 And m + 33 <= 194 Then
        L2.Span m, 7, 3, &HFF : L2.Span m + 30, 7, 3, &HFF
        L2.Span m, 41, 3, &HFF : L2.Span m + 30, 41, 3, &HFF
        mark0 = m
    Else
        mark0 = -1
    End If
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' MAIN PROGRAM ENTRY
' ============================================================================

Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Board.Init
L2.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL
SetPens
Border 0
Paper 0
Pen 15
ClsAll
MakeLand
Heights

' the sprites: DEFENDER.SPR if it's there, the built-in set if not
LoadSpriteTilemap("DEFENDER.SPR")

Do
    TitleScreen

    score = 0 : nextBonus = 10000
    lives = 3
    bombs = 3
    wave = 1
    game_over = False
    InitWave()

    Do While Not game_over
        Vsync
        frames = frames + 1
        If flash_bg > 0 Then
            flash_bg = flash_bg - 1
            If flash_bg = 0 Then
                Border 0
                Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, 0, 0
            End If
        End If
        If msgT > 0 Then
            msgT = msgT - 1
            If msgT = 0 Then At 1, 11 : PrintS Space$(32)
        End If

        Controls
        DrawPlayer
        Lasers
        Humans
        Enemies
        If Not game_over Then Shots
        Booms
        Terrain cam_x
        ViewMarks
        If hudDirty Then UpdateHUD()

        ' wave complete: a bonus for each human left
        If enemies_alive <= 0 And enemies_to_spawn <= 0 And Not game_over Then
            WaveDone
        End If
    Loop

    ' Game Over Screen
    HideAllSprites()
    ClsAll
    Scroll.Show 0, 0
    Pen 10
    At 8, 9
    PrintS "G A M E   O V E R"
    Pen 15
    At 8, 12
    PrintS "FINAL SCORE: " & Mid$(Str$(score), 2)
    Pen 14
    At 8, 15
    PrintS "REACHED WAVE: " & Mid$(Str$(wave), 2)
    For i = 1 To 150
        Vsync
    Next i
Loop

Sub WaveDone()
    Dim b As Integer, f As Integer
    For i = 0 To MAX_ENEMIES - 1
        If estate(i) = ST_BAITER Then estate(i) = ST_DEAD : HideSprite(SLOT_ENEMY0 + i)
    Next i
    b = humans_alive * 100 * wave
    If b > 5000 Then b = 5000
    Pen 14
    At 9, 10 : PrintS "ATTACK WAVE" & Str$(wave)
    At 11, 11 : PrintS "COMPLETED"
    Pen 15
    At 9, 13 : PrintS "BONUS" & Str$(b)
    For f = 0 To 5
        Sfx.Play f Mod 3, 120 - f * 12, 0, 13, 12, 0
        For i = 1 To 10
            Vsync
        Next i
    Next f
    AddScore b
    For i = 1 To 60
        Vsync
    Next i
    wave = wave + 1
    If bombs < 5 Then bombs = bombs + 1
    InitWave()
End Sub

Sub TitleScreen()
    Dim t As Integer, a As Integer
    HideAllSprites()
    ClsAll
    Scroll.Show 0, 0
    Stars
    L2.Big 24, 6, "DEFENDER", 3, &HFC, &HE0
    Pen 11
    At 5, 6
    PrintS "ZX SPECTRUM NEXT EDITION"
    Pen 15
    At 9, 9 : PrintS "LANDER      150"
    At 9, 11 : PrintS "MUTANT      150"
    At 9, 13 : PrintS "BAITER      200"
    At 9, 15 : PrintS "HUMANOID    500"
    Pen 12
    At 3, 17 : PrintS "Q / A or UP/DN : ALTITUDE"
    At 3, 18 : PrintS "O / P or LT/RT : THRUST"
    At 3, 19 : PrintS "SPACE / FIRE 1 : LASER"
    At 3, 20 : PrintS "B / M / FIRE 2 : SMART BOMB"
    At 3, 21 : PrintS "H              : HYPERSPACE"
    t = 0
    Do
        Vsync
        t = t + 1
        a = (t \ 8) And 1
        SetHardwareSprite(1, 56, 195 - 9 * 8, PAT_LANDER + a * PAT_FRAME2, False, True)
        SetHardwareSprite(2, 56, 195 - 11 * 8, PAT_MUTANT + a * PAT_FRAME2, False, True)
        SetHardwareSprite(3, 56, 195 - 13 * 8, PAT_BAITER + a, False, True)
        SetHardwareSprite(4, 56, 195 - 15 * 8, PAT_HUMAN + a * PAT_FRAME2, False, True)
        ' the ship flies across the bottom
        SetHardwareSprite(0, (t * 2) Mod 300 - 20, 6, PAT_PLAYER + a * PAT_FRAME2, False, True)
        Pen 10
        At 7, 23
        If (t \ 25) And 1 Then PrintS "PRESS SPACE OR FIRE" Else PrintS "                   "
        k = Rnd(10)
    Loop Until Key(40) Or (Joy(0) And 16) <> 0
    Do
        Vsync
    Loop While Key(40) Or (Joy(0) And 16) <> 0
    HideAllSprites()
End Sub

' ============================================================================
' THE ORIGINAL'S CPC-STYLE STATEMENTS, ON THE NEXT
' ============================================================================

' the pens: Layer 2 colours (RRRGGGBB) for drawing; the words' palette rows
Sub SetPens()
    For k = 0 To 15
        penc(k) = Val(Mid$("000 003 224 028 031 226 252 255 146 002 224 031 028 226 252 255", k * 4 + 1, 3))
    Next k
    Board.Pal 2, "00FF00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 3, "00FC00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 4, "001F00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 5, "00E000000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 6, "001C00000000000000000000000025E3"
    Board.Pal 7, "00E200000000000000000000000025E3"
End Sub

' Pen n: the colour for the words that follow
Sub Pen(ByVal n As Integer)
    Select Case n
        Case 14: txtPen = 3
        Case 11: txtPen = 4
        Case 10: txtPen = 5
        Case 12: txtPen = 6
        Case 13: txtPen = 7
        Case Else: txtPen = 2
    End Select
End Sub

Sub Paper(ByVal n As Integer)
End Sub

Sub Border(ByVal n As Integer)
    Nx.Border n And 7
End Sub

' At x, y: where the words go (1, 1 = the top left of the 32 x 24 picture)
Sub At(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
    atx = x + 3 : aty = y + 3
End Sub

Sub PrintS(ByVal t As String)
    Board.Text atx, aty, t, txtPen
    atx = atx + Len(t)
End Sub

Sub ClsAll()
    Board.Clear
    L2.Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
    For k = 0 To 255
        ycol(k) = -1
    Next k
    terOn = 0
End Sub

' Plot x, y, c: a point (y counts up from the bottom, as on the CPC), and the start of the next Draw
Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
    gx = x : gy = y
    If x >= 0 And x < 256 And y >= 0 And y < 192 Then L2.Plot x, 191 - y, penc(c And 15)
End Sub

' Draw x, y, c: a line from the last point to x, y
Sub Draw(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
    Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, sx1 As Integer, sy1 As Integer, e As Integer, e2 As Integer, x0 As Integer, y0 As Integer, col As Integer
    col = penc(c And 15)
    x0 = gx : y0 = gy
    dx = Abs(x - x0) : dy = -Abs(y - y0)
    If x0 < x Then sx1 = 1 Else sx1 = -1
    If y0 < y Then sy1 = 1 Else sy1 = -1
    e = dx + dy
    Do
        If x0 >= 0 And x0 < 256 And y0 >= 0 And y0 < 192 Then L2.Plot x0, 191 - y0, col
        If x0 = x And y0 = y Then Exit Do
        e2 = e * 2
        If e2 >= dy Then e = e + dy : x0 = x0 + sx1
        If e2 <= dx Then e = e + dx : y0 = y0 + sy1
    Loop
    gx = x : gy = y
End Sub

' Sound ch, pitch, length, volume: the original's sounds, on the AY (channel 1 = A, 2 = B)
Sub Sound(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal pitch As Integer, ByVal dur As Integer, ByVal vol As Integer)
    Sfx.Play (ch - 1) Mod 3, pitch, 0, vol, dur * 2 + 1, 0
End Sub

' Vsync: wait for the next frame (and keep the sound and the copper going)
Sub Vsync()
    Frame
    Scroll.Upload
    Sfx.Update
End Sub

' Key(n): the original's key numbers, on the Next's keyboard
Function Key(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
    Select Case n
        Case 40: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace)
        Case 3: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ)
        Case 2: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA)
        Case 33: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO)
        Case 32: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP)
        Case 9: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ)
        Case 36: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyB)
        Case 34: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM)
        Case 38: Key = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyH)
        Case Else: Key = 0
    End Select
End Function

' Joy(0): the joystick as the original's bits (1 right, 2 left, 4 down, 8 up, 16 fire, 32 fire 2)
Function Joy(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
    Dim j0 As Integer, r As Integer
    j0 = Keys.Joystick(n)
    r = 0
    If j0 And Keys.JoyRight Then r = r Or 1
    If j0 And Keys.JoyLeft Then r = r Or 2
    If j0 And Keys.JoyDown Then r = r Or 4
    If j0 And Keys.JoyUp Then r = r Or 8
    If j0 And Keys.JoyFire1 Then r = r Or 16
    If j0 And Keys.JoyFire2 Then r = r Or 32
    Joy = r
End Function

' The terrain. Layer 2's column (wx And 255) holds world x wx; the copper scrolls the bottom of
' the screen (from line 160) by cx And 255 and the sky (lines 44-159, the stars) by a quarter of
' that, so the screen shows world x cx .. cx + 255 there. Only the columns that come into view
' since last time are drawn.
Sub Terrain(ByVal cx As Integer)
    Dim d As Integer
    If terDead <> planet_dead Then Heights
    If terOn = 0 Or terDead <> planet_dead Then
        For k = 0 To 255
            Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
        Next k
    Else
        d = (cx - tcam) And WORLD_MASK
        If d >= 512 Then d = d - 1024
        If d >= 256 Or d <= -256 Then
            For k = 0 To 255
                Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
            Next k
        ElseIf d > 0 Then
            For k = 256 - d To 255
                Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
            Next k
        ElseIf d < 0 Then
            For k = 0 To -d - 1
                Col (cx + k) And WORLD_MASK
            Next k
        End If
    End If
    terOn = 1 : terDead = planet_dead : tcam = cx
    Scroll.Show (cx \ 4) And 255, cx And 255
End Sub

' one column of the terrain: the old pixel off, the new on (its height worked out beforehand: Heights)
Sub Col(ByVal wx As Integer)
    Dim c As Integer
    c = wx And 255
    If ycol(c) >= 0 Then L2.Plot c, ycol(c), 0
    ycol(c) = yh(wx)
    L2.Plot c, ycol(c), COL_TERRAIN
End Sub

' the ground's line for every x of the world (Layer 2 y, top down), sloping between the 4-pixel
' steps of GetTerrainY
Sub Heights()
    Dim wx As Integer, h0 As Integer, h1 As Integer
    For wx = 0 To WORLD_MASK
        h0 = GetTerrainY(wx) : h1 = GetTerrainY((wx + 4) And WORLD_MASK)
        yh(wx) = 191 - (h0 + (h1 - h0) * (wx And 3) \ 4)
    Next wx
End Sub

' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Board.cls
files.text:
' Board - the card table on the Next's tilemap: 40 x 32 cells, 2 bytes each (the tile, its palette
' row), so each card can be in its own colours. The tiles (GfxData) at bank 5 + #0000, the map at
' bank 5 + #2000 (#E000).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private tc As Integer

' Init: the tilemap with attributes (after Tiles.Init and GfxData.Load)
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &H81                        ' the tilemap: on, 40 x 32, 2 bytes a cell, 4 bit
  Clear
End Sub

' Clear: every cell tile 0 (see-through)
Public Sub Clear()
#asm
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 2559
            ld (hl), 0
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Put x, y, t, p: cell x, y shows tile t in palette row p
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; DE = #E000 + (y * 40 + x) * 2
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
            ld de, #E000
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Text x, y, s, p: a string from cell x, y in palette row p (the font is the tiles 32-95)
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
            ld de, #E000
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld ({tc}), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld c, a
            ld hl, ({tc})
st_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, st_done
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld a, d
            cp #EA
            jr nc, st_done
            jr st_lp
st_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t, p: a block of one tile
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t, p
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Pal row, s: the tilemap's palette row (0-15) from s, 16 colours as hex pairs (RRRGGGBB)
Public Sub Pal(ByVal row As Integer, ByVal s As String)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To 15
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, row * 16 + k, Hx(s, k)
  Next
End Sub

' Hx(s, k): the k-th hex pair in s
Private Function Hx(ByVal s As String, ByVal k As Integer) As Integer
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer
  a = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 1, 1)) : b = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 2, 1))
  If a > 57 Then a = a - 55 Else a = a - 48
  If b > 57 Then b = b - 55 Else b = b - 48
  Hx = a * 16 + b
End Function

files.name: L2.cls
files.text:
' L2 - Layer 2 for the backdrops: 256 x 192, one byte a pixel (RRRGGGBB colours), bank 16 (pages
' 32-37, each 32 lines, put in at #C000 through MMU slot 6 while drawing, then bank 5's page 10
' back). Behind the tilemap and the sprites.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private sc As Integer, sw As Integer, fa As Integer, pb As Integer, vis As Integer

' Init: Layer 2 on, 256 x 192, no scroll, the whole of it
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Out &H123B, 2
  ' two screens: bank 16 and bank 19. Both cleared; bank 16 is shown and drawn on
  vis = 19 : pb = 38
  Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
  vis = 16 : pb = 32
  Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
End Sub

' Back: draw on the screen that isn't shown (until Flip)
Public Sub Back()
  If vis = 16 Then pb = 38 Else pb = 32
End Sub

' Flip: show the screen just drawn on (and keep drawing on it)
Public Sub Flip()
  vis = pb \ 2
  Nx.Reg &H12, vis
End Sub

' Span x, y, w, c: w pixels (1-256, not past the right edge) of colour c from x, y
Public Sub Span(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; y
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; w
            ld ({sw}), bc
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({sc}), a            ; colour
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld h, a
            ld a, ({pb})
            add a, h
            ld h, a                 ; the page: pb + y / 32
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, h
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e                 ; HL = #C000 + (y And 31) * 256 + x
            ld bc, ({sw})
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld a, ({sc})
            ld (hl), a
            dec bc
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            inc de
            ldir
l2_back:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, c: a block
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    Span x, j, w, c
  Next
End Sub

' Plot x, y, c: one pixel
Public Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  If x >= 0 And x < 256 And y >= 0 And y < 192 Then Span x, y, 1, c
End Sub

' Big x, y, s, z, c1, c2: text s drawn z times the size, colour c1 on top shading to c2, with a
' dark shadow (colour 0) two pixels down and right. The letters are read from the tilemap's font
' (tiles 32-95 at #C000, 4 bits a pixel: colour 1 is the letter)
Public Sub Big(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, i As Integer, run As Integer, a As Integer, col As Integer, pass As Integer, sh As Integer, m As Integer, v As Integer
  For pass = 0 To 1
    sh = (1 - pass) * 2
    For k = 1 To Len(s)
      a = &HC000 + Asc(Mid$(s, k, 1)) * 32
      For r = 0 To 7
        b = 0 : m = 128
        For i = 0 To 3
          v = Peek(a + r * 4 + i)
          If (v \ 16) = 1 Then b = b Or m
          If (v And 15) = 1 Then b = b Or (m \ 2)
          m = m \ 4
        Next
        col = 0
        If pass Then
          col = c2
          If r < 4 Then col = c1
        End If
        i = 0
        Do While b
          If b And 128 Then
            run = 0
            Do While b And 128
              run = run + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
            Loop
            Rect x + ((k - 1) * 8 + i) * z + sh, y + r * z + sh, run * z, z, col
            i = i + run
          Else
            i = i + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
          End If
        Loop
      Next
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Scroll - the copper scrolls Layer 2 sideways: not at all at the top (the scanner), by the stars'
' amount from line 44 (the sky), by the ground's from line 160 (the terrain). Show sets them for
' the next frame; Upload (straight after Frame) hands the list to the copper.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private cop(19) As Byte

Public Sub Show(ByVal stars As Integer, ByVal ground As Integer)
  cop(0) = &H80 : cop(1) = 0                ' line 0:
  cop(2) = &H16 : cop(3) = 0                '   no scroll
  cop(4) = &H80 : cop(5) = 44               ' line 44: the sky
  cop(6) = &H16 : cop(7) = stars And 255
  cop(8) = &H80 : cop(9) = 160              ' line 160: the ground
  cop(10) = &H16 : cop(11) = ground And 255
  cop(12) = &HFF : cop(13) = &HFF           ' the end
End Sub

Public Sub Upload()
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #61
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a              ; stopped, index 0
            dec b
            ld a, #60
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld hl, {cop}
            ld e, 14
sc_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, sc_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, #C0
            out (c), a              ; start: from 0, again at each frame
#endasm
End Sub
